name: Invoice financing review
notice: Validate invoices, delivery evidence, and supporting documents before financing assessment.
supported_contract: Business documents in supported file formats; interpreted using their stated currencies, units, line items and adjustments.

requirements.label: Invoice amounts are consistent
requirements.description: Assess invoice accuracy across all line items, quantities, prices, taxes, discounts, credits and other charges. Reconcile the stated totals using the document’s currencies and rounding conventions. Identify missing information and inconsistencies.

requirements.label: Delivery receipts cover the full invoiced quantity
requirements.description: Assess whether evidence of receipt accounts for the invoiced items and quantities. Match parties, references, items and units in context. Account for partial and cumulative deliveries without double-counting, and identify shortfalls, conflicts or unsupported conversions. Dispatch alone does not confirm receipt.

requirements.label: Invoice is not already on another case in this book
requirements.description: The same seller, invoice number and stated amount must not already appear on another open or completed case in this organisation. A hold here is a book-level control; it is not a financing decision and it is not the same as a copied file on one case.

missing_receipt.label: Missing delivery receipt
missing_receipt.text: Please provide delivery receipt evidence for the remaining {outstanding_quantity} {unit} of {item} under invoice {invoice_number}. Each receipt must come from {receipt_issuers}, reference {invoice_number} and identify a delivery that is distinct from {known_deliveries}. A dispatch notice does not confirm receipt.

invoice_correction.label: Invoice correction
invoice_correction.text: Invoice {invoice_number} states a total of {stated_total}, but {quantity} {unit} × {unit_price} = {expected_total}. Please provide a replacement invoice issued by {seller_name} that explicitly replaces version {invoice_version}, or explain the difference.

invoice_replacement_clarification.label: Replacement invoice clarification
invoice_replacement_clarification.text: The replacement invoice received for {invoice_number} could not be accepted: {rejection}. Please provide a replacement issued by {seller_name} that explicitly replaces version {invoice_version} and changes only the corrected amount.

receipt_correction.label: Receipt correction (authorised by reviewer)
receipt_correction.text: A statement received on this case disputes receipt {receipt_number}. Please provide a corrected receipt from {receipt_issuers} that explicitly replaces {receipt_number} version {receipt_version} and states the quantity received for delivery {delivery_ref}, plus separate receipt evidence for any remaining {unit} of {item} under {invoice_number}.

supported_document.label: Supported document format
supported_document.text: Document {document_label} needs attention: {rejection}. Please provide the missing information or a readable copy.

receipt_basis_clarification.label: Receipt basis clarification
receipt_basis_clarification.text: Receipt {receipt_label} for {invoice_number} states a cumulative quantity or conflicts with another receipt for the same delivery. Please provide a corrected receipt from {receipt_issuers} that explicitly replaces it and states only the quantity received in that delivery, so each delivery is counted once.
